description: Defines sync behavior for Workload Orchestration Framework (WOF) updates

overwrite.description: Files that are always overwritten on sync (framework core)

skip_if_customized.description: Files that are skipped if they've been modified locally

always_preserve.description: Files that are never touched by sync

template_only.description: Files created from templates only during setup, not updated on sync

deprecated.description: Files from v1 format that are auto-migrated to v2 and backed up
deprecated.note: These files are still supported but will be migrated on sync
